summary: ABaiocchi 提出把临时密钥轮换直接做进 EIP-8141 frame 交易，用单例注册合约把签名权与链上身份分离以抵御量子攻击。CarlBeek 的 Quick Slots EIP 合并（EIP-8198），adietrichs 介绍把 slot 时间像 gas limit 一样参数化逐步缩短。ethrex 实现 EIP-8025 可选执行证明。

items.topic: 原生 AA 与后量子：临时密钥轮换
items.title: ethresear.ch：通过 frame 交易原生轮换临时密钥
items.note: （ABaiocchi）22:49：延续此前基于临时密钥与账户抽象实现量子安全的文章，提议把密钥轮换直接纳入 EIP-8141 frame 交易格式，无需单独的 AA 层，用单例注册合约在协议层把签名权与链上身份分离，并借助 frame 交易的原生打包加入轮换 frame。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Native Ephemeral Key Rotation via Frame Transactions
items.note_en: (ABaiocchi), 22:49: following an earlier post on quantum safety through ephemeral key pairs and account abstraction, it builds key rotation into the EIP-8141 frame transaction format with no separate AA layer, decoupling signing authority from onchain identity via a singleton registry and adding a rotation frame through native bundling.

keywords_en: Native ephemeral key rotation via frame transactions
summary_en: ABaiocchi proposed building ephemeral key rotation directly into EIP-8141 frame transactions, decoupling signing authority from onchain identity with a singleton registry for quantum safety. CarlBeek's Quick Slots EIP merged (EIP-8198), and adietrichs presented parameterizing slot time like the gas limit to shorten it over time. ethrex implemented EIP-8025 optional execution proofs.
